verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Payment Links API for generating shareable payment links, and its official hosted MCP server explicitly exposes that API, so an agent can create a payment link in a session. The evidence shows no product or price catalog objects that an agent could provision first, so only the payment-link part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: API-level product creation, API-level price objects, evidence of a single-session product→price→link flow, and hands-on corroboration.
